notes.title: Major Demo Update!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that a new OVERRIDER demo has been released! This one changes the very foundation of the game by adding more structure and regular upgrades. 

In addition,  we have new abilities levels and challenges for you to take on. 

Give it a try and if you have a spare minute, we'd love it if you gave us some quick feedback via this form: https://forms.gle/2EcEN3uaGajyFjtz8

notes.title: Demo and Kickstarter Campaign - LIVE!
notes.content:
With great excitement we announce that OVERRIDER is now LIVE ON KICKSTARTER! 

Join us as we embark on this high-speed adventure together!

By backing us on Kickstarter, you not only support the development of OVERRIDER but also gain access to exclusive rewards and behind-the-scenes insights into the making of the game.

PLEDGE TODAY

And that's not all! To celebrate our launch, we just released a brand new demo which you can play right now. So go give it a spin! We're eager to hear your feedback.

notes.title: BETA V2 Closed Playtest
notes.content:
OVERRIDER Has Changed
After we showcased OVERRIDER on Steam Next Fest in October we got a lot of feedback which showed us a lot of things we haven't been doing right. From movement mechanics, through enemy engagement to core loop. Over the past month our studio has been working hard to introduce design changes and now it's time to do another test.

Join The Playtest
The playtest will take place between November 17th and 24th be closed. To gain access, fill in the form balow:

https://forms.gle/kBR6UdougsPP6hSk7
